review_scope: repository standards and provenance; complete Program 007 source-contract specification; raw-first ordering; XNYS projection; pagination and zero retry; action-ledger disposition and exact share-unit normalization; capability-held private evidence; same-process concurrency; authority and privacy boundaries

review_results.standards: The earlier provenance finding is resolved by immutable V6 implementation and review artifacts plus state, roadmap, decision, secret-guard, and regression-test bindings.
review_results.specification: No material source/spec correctness findings at the bound source commit. Exact qualification completeness is correct; unresolved ledger coverage remains an explicit pre-authority blocker rather than an implementation defect.
review_results.storage_boundary: No material findings after the final per-source RLock fix. The unnamed evidence descriptor removes child-path inode provenance from all evidence reads and writes.

resolved_findings.finding: Descriptor-relative child path opens could accept attacker-selected pre-existing external inodes.
resolved_findings.resolution: All logical evidence now uses one unnamed file descriptor opened during source construction; workspace child paths are never reopened.

resolved_findings.finding: flock on one shared open-file description did not serialize same-process threads.
resolved_findings.resolution: One exact per-source RLock now covers evidence load, validation, append, fsync, and flock release; a barrier regression proves the second caller waits.

verification.independent_reviewers: fresh standards, specification, and storage-boundary reviewers
verification.focused_tests: 46 passed across Program 007 source and forensic tests
verification.secret_private_data_scan: passed after staging V6 and review artifacts

proof_gap: The synthetic evidence log persists only while the same SyntheticPageSource object holds its unnamed descriptor. A future authorized real transport needs a separately reviewed persistent store. This review did not resolve public unit-changing-action coverage for IWM, MDY, or SPY and did not inspect credentials, private observations, providers, strategy outputs, controlled or protected state, PAPER, broker, or live state.
